# Gimmir

> Gimmir is two founders, Nazar Moroz and Oleh Palazhii, who build SaaS products their clients own outright: code, accounts, IP and roadmap in the client's name from the first commit. Nine products shipped, four of them in fitness, where we go deepest. Gimmir LLC is a Delaware (US) company; the team works from the EU.

We work with two kinds of clients:

- Brands: fitness franchises and chains with 8+ locations that rent a white-label app platform whose fees grow with every site. We move them onto their own member app, franchise CRM and payments, site by site.
- Founders: business owners with a business or an audience who want to turn it into a SaaS product they own. We did it for ourselves first, with Jimmy Coach.

Wellness, yes; regulated clinical products, no.

## Case studies

- [UN1T](https://gimmir.com/work/un1t): a London-founded boutique fitness franchise with 10+ locations, moved off a white-label platform onto its own member app, franchise CRM and payments in 12 weeks. Oleh led the architecture.
- [Jimmy Coach](https://gimmir.com/work/jimmy-coach): an online coaching app Nazar co-founded with Quentin Randis, a Hyrox and CrossFit coach, and one we co-own: one iOS and Android app and a web dashboard, with 200+ coaches two months after launch.
